stepNotes.1: EventRoutes is a lazy Hono sub-app (event.ts:17) exposing one route, GET /event, mounted at server root (server.ts:321); OpenAPI schema driven by BusEvent.payloads() (event.ts:29).
stepNotes.2: Three defended failure modes: backpressure cap at SSE_HARD_MAX=4096 (sse-queue.ts:33), cross-workspace filter via shouldForward + requestDirectory validation (event.ts:110, request-directory.ts:27-69), and try/catch around heartbeat push (event.ts:99-106). No empty catches.
stepNotes.3: stop() is idempotent via the done flag across four call sites; connected frame enqueued before Bus.subscribeAll; Bus.publish iterates a copied subscriber array so in-band unsub cannot corrupt iteration (bus/index.ts:68).
stepNotes.4: heartbeat setInterval is unref'd (event.ts:108) and cleared in stop(); Bus subscription released via unsub(); AsyncQueue uses null sentinel instead of close() but for-await terminates cleanly on it (queue.ts:59-75).
stepNotes.5: Dual-cap design: data frames hard-disconnect at 4096, control frames silently drop at 256 (event.ts:84), both comparing against shared q.size; encodeSsePayload handles bigint/circular (sse-queue.ts:44-64); warned latch prevents log flooding.
stepNotes.6: Two non-blocking inconsistencies: pushControl uses raw JSON.stringify bypassing encodeSsePayload (event.ts:87), and route uses null sentinel rather than AsyncQueue.close() (queue.ts:35-41) so the queue's closed invariant is never set.
stepNotes.7: No dead code, TODOs, or magic numbers; HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS and CONTROL_FRAME_QUEUE_LIMIT are named constants; structural test at route-validation.test.ts:1070-1077 pins the finally/q.push(null) cleanup invariant.
stepNotes.8: No Critical or High findings; two INFO notes (control-frame serialization path divergence; null-sentinel vs close()). Consistent with empty MODULE-AUDIT register at MODULE-AUDIT.md:60-64.
stepNotes.9: Read-only review; existing tests are structural (route-validation.test.ts:1070-1084) or target the sibling control-plane server (workspace-server-sse.test.ts). Non-blocking coverage gap: no direct test for the 256 control-frame drop or the 4096 overflow disconnect path. No Critical item so no reverify.md produced by this primary review.
